title: Petra and the Lantern
author: Felix Reyes
blurb: Jude Oyelaran, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
